subject: Kiosk opt-in workflow & SFDC field mapping for CloudSummit
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: LeadMagnet Ops <ops@leadmagnet.io>, CloudSummit Events <events@cloudsummit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kiosk opt-in workflow & SFDC field mapping for CloudSummit

Hi team —

We're finalizing the lead capture workflow for the Booth A kiosk at CloudSummit (Sept 10-12). Rather than the old paper scanners we want a simple QR+kiosk option that:
- captures name, company, title, email (required)
- captures phone (optional) and a free-text note field
- captures source metadata: campaign, booth_id, utm params when available
- includes a single opt-in checkbox with the exact consent copy below (see attachment optin_copy_v2.txt)

Two integration questions:
1) Can LeadMagnet push leads to our Salesforce org via API in near-real-time? If so, we need the exact SFDC API field names to map to — I'll paste our preferred mapping in my next reply. If not, confirm CSV batch export cadence (hourly acceptable).
2) Where are consumer-facing consent records stored (kiosk vendor or in our CRM)? We need an auditable copy stored in Redwood logs for 90 days at minimum.

Please confirm timeline to turn up a staging kiosk and a test leadflow we can exercise next week. Also attach the simple data spec if you have one.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: optin_copy_v2.txt (text)

From: LeadMagnet Ops <ops@leadmagnet.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudSummit Events <events@cloudsummit.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk opt-in workflow & SFDC field mapping for CloudSummit

Hi Tessa —

Thanks — we can do API push to Salesforce (we support both REST API and bulk CSV). A few quick clarifying q's before we map fields:
- Do you want Lead records or Contact+Lead (Lead object preferred for event capture)?
- Do you have a required external_id or dedupe key (email alone, or email+company)?
- Consent storage: by default we keep a consent snapshot on our side for 120 days; we can also post a copy of the consent text into a SFDC text field on the Lead object. Which do you prefer?

Quick note: we attached our integration guide (leadmagnet_integration_guide.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
1) You send the SFDC field API names and required values (Campaign, Lead Source, etc.).
2) We create a staging kiosk URL and API credentials for Redwood to test (we can have that ready in 48 hours).

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Ops Lead — LeadMagnet Inc.

Attachments: leadmagnet_integration_guide.pdf (PDF)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: LeadMagnet Ops <ops@leadmagnet.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk opt-in workflow & SFDC field mapping for CloudSummit

Diego —

Thanks for the quick reply. We want to create Lead records in SFDC. Deduping should be email-first; if email missing then fallback to email+company. Please map to the following SFDC API names (attached CSV also):

Required mapping (API name -> kiosk field):
- Lead.Company -> company
- Lead.LastName -> last_name (if only single name provided, put full name in LastName)
- Lead.FirstName -> first_name
- Lead.Email -> email
- Lead.Phone -> phone
- Lead.Title -> title
- Lead.LeadSource -> LeadSource (set to CloudSummit2025)
- Lead.Campaign__c -> Campaign (set to CloudSummit2025-BoothA)
- Lead.Opt_In_Text__c -> consent_snapshot (store the full string of the checkbox copy)
- Lead.utm_source__c -> utm_source
- Lead.utm_medium__c -> utm_medium
- Lead.utm_campaign__c -> utm_campaign

Consent copy (exact):
"I agree to receive emails from Redwood Inference about product updates and event follow-ups. I understand my information will be used according to Redwood's Privacy Policy (link) and may be stored for a limited time for event operations."

Other requirements:
- Please capture a timestamp and kiosk_id on every lead (kiosk_id -> Lead.Kiosk_ID__c).
- We want a raw payload webhook in a Drive folder for 90 days for audits.

I've attached kiosk_field_mapping_v1.csv with API names. If you can set up the staging kiosk and send credentials, we'll run test submissions and validate SFDC mapping.

Thanks —
Tessa

Attachments: kiosk_field_mapping_v1.csv (CSV), optin_copy_v2.txt (text)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, LeadMagnet Ops <ops@leadmagnet.io>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk opt-in workflow & SFDC field mapping for CloudSummit

One quick ask — can we also capture UTM params when attendees hit the QR and include an optional phone field? Phone is useful for SDR follow-up but should remain optional for privacy. Otherwise this looks good to me.

-M

From: LeadMagnet Ops <ops@leadmagnet.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Aug 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiosk opt-in workflow & SFDC field mapping for CloudSummit

Thanks — we can accommodate all items. Summary of what we'll deliver by EOD Mon:
- staging kiosk URL: https://staging.leadmagnet.io/kiosk/boothA?test=true (credentials below)
- API push to your SFDC org to Lead object with the mapping in kiosk_field_mapping_v1.csv
- consent snapshot posted to Lead.Opt_In_Text__c and stored on our side for 120 days; we'll also drop raw payloads to the Drive link you provided for 90 days
- UTM capture and optional phone field enabled

Testing details:
Username: redwood_test@leadmagnet.io
Password: TempPass!2025
Please run 3 test leads (one with email, one without email, one with utm params) and share the resulting SFDC Lead IDs so we can confirm dedupe behavior.

We'll also include an integration checklist and a small CSV export of the first 24 hours post-event.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
LeadMagnet Inc.

Attachments: none
